findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "stream" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: study_concept · Private data: create_crossword, create_fill_blank, create_infographic, create_match_pair, create_mcq, create_podcast, create_ranking, edit_crossword, edit_fill_blank, edit_flashcards, edit_infographic, edit_match_pair, edit_mcq, edit_podcast, edit_quiz, edit_ranking · Public sink: play_chess · Destructive: create_quiz, remove_liked_course.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: study_concept · Private data: create_crossword, create_fill_blank, create_infographic, create_match_pair, create_mcq, create_podcast, create_ranking, edit_crossword, edit_fill_blank, edit_flashcards, edit_infographic, edit_match_pair, edit_mcq, edit_podcast, edit_quiz, edit_ranking · Public sink: play_chess · Destructive: create_quiz, remove_liked_course

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
